title: HTML to Markdown Converter: how it works, formula and examples

content:
The [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Turn HTML into clean Markdown — headings, links, lists and code. Enter your HTML and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like. Turn HTML into clean Markdown: headings become #, bold becomes **, links become Markdown links, lists become -, and code blocks become fenced blocks. It is the quick way to convert a page or a snippet into text you can paste into a README, a blog post or documentation. Scripts and styles are dropped, and the rest of the markup is stripped. Everything runs in your browser; your content is never uploaded. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. ## How to use the HTML to Markdown Converter Start by typing or pasting your HTML. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults. The steps below walk through each input in order. 1. Paste your HTML into the editor (or use the sample). 2. Click Convert — the Markdown appears below. 3. Copy it into your document. ## How it works The [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) works straight from the values you enter: change an input and the result updates immediately, with no page reload and no waiting. Everything happens in your browser, so your entries never leave your device. Try it with a few different values and you will quickly get a feel for how the inputs move the result. ## Worked example Here is a typical example. Converting `

Hello

A link.

` gives `# Hello` followed by a paragraph with a link to example.com. Try the same figures in the [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change. ## Trying it out The fastest way to see what the [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) does is to open it and enter values you already know the answer for. Change one input at a time and watch how the result responds — that tells you more than any description. Everything runs in your browser, so you can experiment freely: nothing is saved, sent or tracked. ## What converts Headings h1–h6, paragraphs, bold and italic, links and images, unordered and ordered lists, inline code and fenced code blocks, blockquotes and horizontal rules. Tables and complex layouts are simplified to their text — Markdown has no native table support in this converter. ## What is dropped Script and style blocks are removed entirely, and any tag the converter does not recognise is stripped while its text is kept. The result is plain, portable Markdown. ## Tips A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself: - Convert a copied web page snippet before pasting it into a Markdown document. - Check links after converting — their addresses are preserved as Markdown links. - Code blocks come through as fenced blocks, ready for a README. Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in. ## Frequently asked questions ### What does HTML to Markdown do? It converts HTML markup into Markdown text: headings become #, links become Markdown links, lists become -, and so on — so the content works in any Markdown document. Try it with your own numbers in the [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds. ### Are scripts and styles kept? No. Script and style blocks are removed, and unrecognised tags are stripped while their text is kept. Try it with your own numbers in the [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds. ### Is my HTML uploaded anywhere? No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Try it with your own numbers in the [HTML to Markdown Converter](/html-to-markdown-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds. ### What do I need to use the HTML to Markdown Converter? Just HTML. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly. ## Related tools If this calculation is part of a bigger job, the other Text Tools tools on CalcHub can help. The [Word Counter](/word-counter), [Character Counter](/character-counter), [Reading Time Calculator](/reading-time-calculator) and [Remove Spaces](/remove-spaces) all work the same way — enter your values and the result appears instantly, free and with no sign-up.
